claimsToVerify: Pharaohs performed daily morning temple rituals to maintain Ma'at (cosmic balance).
Pharaohs spent significant daily time on state administration, grain storage, and building oversight.
Morning ritual purifications with water and oils were standard for Egyptian royalty and high priests.
